title: Abdominal Imaging with Contrast-enhanced Photon-counting CT: First Human Experience
lineage: Primary NIH Clinical Center study, coauthored by an engineer from Siemens. Reports the exact enrollment period and the research use of the hybrid detector architecture.

passages.locator: Abstract, Materials and Methods; Materials and Methods, Subjects
passages.note: Fifteen volunteers were prospectively enrolled from 2 September to 13 November 2015. The study obtained both PCD and EID images.
The scanner combines one energy-integrating detector and one photon-counting detector on a dual-source system.
The authors submitted the results on 24 November 2015. This is a conservative upper bound on the demonstration, separate from the recruitment date.
